title: Lower bound μ_T(W) ≤ M_W(T) for open W ⊆ U
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U with R.Represents T. Then for every open W ⊆ U, μ_T(W) ≤ M_W(T), i.e. R.measure W ≤ T.massOn W, where R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ and T.massOn W = sup{ofReal T(ω) : ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), spt ω ⊆ W, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1 ∀x}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → R.measure W ≤ T.massOn W
